_comment: Golden fixture for intraday guard-alpha dollar-saved math (AC-1). Values are derivable from inputs — do not hardcode; use these inputs to compute expected outputs in tests. Formula: saved = (current_return - at_return) / 100 * position_value. Positive = bot outperformed held (locked in gains); negative = held beat bot post-exit.

cases.name: basic_positive_divergence
cases.description: Bot exited at +2.0%; held position continued to -1.0% — saved 3pp on $10000
cases.note: at_return=2.0 means bot locked in +2%; current_return=-1.0 means held is now at -1%; divergence = 2-(-1)=3pp saved on $10k = $300

cases.name: negative_divergence_held_won
cases.description: Bot exited at +1.0%; held rallied further to +3.0% — bot gave up 2pp

cases.name: zero_position_value
cases.description: No position basis — saved dollars must be 0.0 regardless of return divergence

cases.name: zero_divergence
cases.description: Current return equals at_return — held and bot same level, no guard alpha

cases.name: large_positive_divergence
cases.description: Vega-type scenario: bot exited at +5%; held crashed to -20%
